tasks.corrected_reference_answer: MidMeasureMP directly inherits MeasurementProcess (pennylane/measurements/mid_measure.py:113-131). measure constructs one and returns a MeasurementValue (104-107); these are not separate execution-strategy subclasses. In qnode.py:899-905, a tape containing MidMeasureMP is selected for deferred measurement when the device is experimental or a legacy device lacks supports_mid_measure. tasks.corrected_reference_answer: There is no guarantee that visualization renders only numerically stable reconstructions. _reconstruct_equ uses a ratio of sinc functions in a Dirichlet-kernel reconstruction (pennylane/fourier/reconstruct.py:59-84). _reconstruct_gen warns if the coefficient matrix condition number exceeds 1e8, then still solves it (155-169). Visualization validation checks list/array type, dimensionality, and odd coefficient-axis sizes (pennylane/fourier/visualize.py:33-80); those structural checks do not establish numerical stability.
